introDialogue.speaker: Echo
introDialogue.text: You have restored every Memory Fragment.

introDialogue.speaker: Echo
introDialogue.text: The objects have returned... but memories alone cannot restore a soul.

introDialogue.speaker: Echo
introDialogue.text: To free Mang Tomas, you must understand the values his life left behind.

introDialogue.speaker: Mang Tomas
introDialogue.text: Tell me... what did my story truly mean?

questions.question: What Filipino value best guided Mang Tomas throughout his life?
The Fish Basket, Rosary, Warning Flag, and Daughter's Drawing together remind us that a meaningful life is built upon...
choices: Family, Faith, Honest Work, and Respect for Nature
questions.answer: Family, Faith, Honest Work, and Respect for Nature

questions.question: Why is Mang Tomas remembered as a true Filipino hero?
choices: He became the richest fisherman in the village.
He put the well-being of others before himself.
He ignored the elders to prove his courage.
He wanted people to remember his name.
questions.answer: He put the well-being of others before himself.

questions.question: What lesson does the sea teach in Mang Tomas' story?
choices: The sea exists to be conquered.
Nature should be respected because it both gives and takes life.
Storms are meant to be challenged.
questions.answer: Nature should be respected because it both gives and takes life.

questions.question: Before sailing, Mang Tomas paused to pray with his rosary. What Filipino value does this represent?
The Daughter's Drawing reminds us that Mang Tomas' greatest treasure was...
The villagers eventually remembered Mang Tomas because...
choices: Every act of kindness deserves to be remembered.
questions.answer: Every act of kindness deserves to be remembered.

questions.question: What is the heart of Mang Tomas' story?
choices: A person's legacy is measured by love, sacrifice, and the lives they touch.
questions.answer: A person's legacy is measured by love, sacrifice, and the lives they touch.

correctDialogue.speaker: Mang Tomas
correctDialogue.text: Yes... you've remembered not only my story, but the values I lived by.

correctDialogue.speaker: Echo
correctDialogue.text: The spirit of our heritage lives on through every memory we choose to keep.
